units.source_text: 6月18日晚上，我把钱揣在怀里，悄然地从寺庙里出来，向通称五番町的北新地走去。

en.t: On the evening of June 18, I tucked the money inside my robe, slipped quietly out of the temple, and walked toward Kitashinchi, commonly known as Gobancho.

units.source_text: 我早就听说那里价格便宜，对寺庙的小和尚也很亲切。

en.t: I had long heard that prices there were cheap and that they were kind even to young temple acolytes.

units.source_text: 五番吁与席克寺的距离徒步得花三四十分钟的光景。

en.t: The distance from Gobancho to Xike Temple took about thirty or forty minutes on foot.
